title: José Clemente Orozco's birth chart
metaDescription: José Clemente Orozco's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 1.2° Sagittarius. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: 0.3° separates Venus and Mars from an exact trine; at that range taste and drive read as one mechanism. A trine runs downhill — the talent that never announces itself because it never had to.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 1.2° Sagittarius — deep enough in the first decan (0°–10°) that Jupiter, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Venus was at 17.4° Sagittarius, Mars was at 17.1° Leo. Read together: attraction declared rather than implied; effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Venus and Mars — a trine holding at 0.3°. A trine runs downhill — the talent that never announces itself because it never had to. Behind it, Mercury opposition Pluto at 0.5°, and the Sun opposition Pluto at 1.0° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: No closed figure — no grand trine, t-square, or grand cross — holds among the day-stable angles. The chart distributes its tension pair by pair rather than through one standing structure.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: No planet here is at home, exalted, in detriment, or in fall. That silence from the oldest layer of the scheme is itself a result, and it moves the weight of the reading onto the geometry.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 8 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 4 fire, 2 air, 2 earth by element and 5 mutable, 3 fixed by mode. Mercury crossed from Scorpio into Sagittarius during that day, so its sign is left open. No settled placement falls in water — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Virgo into Libra during that day at the birthplace, travelling 12.0° between one midnight and the next. Without a recorded hour there is no honest way to say which side it was on, so this reading does not say. The Moon sign is a real question here, not a rounding error, and it needs a birth time nobody has published.
